alt: 包裝室裡只有一個小包裹需要處理，一人忙著封箱，其餘好幾位員工無事可做，站著或坐著等待。
scene_prompt: 人浮於事 means too many staff for too little work. A small contemporary parcel wrapping room with SEVEN adult employees and only ONE tiny parcel to be wrapped on a central table. One employee carefully tapes the small parcel; the others visibly have nothing useful to do: one leans on an unused broom, two idle workers stand with empty hands and puzzled faces, another sits yawning, and two wait behind unused packing stations. Sparse empty shelves and unused tools show very little work available. Distinguish from teamwork: only one pair of hands actually working, and the six others are standing well apart or sitting with clearly idle expressions rather than all reaching to help. Keep each body independent, exactly two arms and legs per person, coherent table supports and stools. Only ONE tiny parcel; no hidden pile of work. No text or labels anywhere. Gentle humorous observation, no mocking poverty.
